title: Integrate theorem-prover admission

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 theorem-prover-admission capability assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: The current datasets head already provides a versioned optional external-prover installer with reviewed target versions and a read-only managed-version status probe. It also provides Leanstral's explicitly non-mutating LegalIR shadow lane, which rejects absent Lean executables and validates only its own LegalIR task/proposal contract. Neither component admits a PCSM theorem obligation: neither consumes a canonical PCSM SourceLinkReceipt/source-map CID nor binds a current PCSM file/node/span, theorem text, tool deployment digest, kernel output, or closed PCSM admission decision. The exact-output authority permits only this receipt, so no wrapper, downloader, source-map authority, test relaxation, or parallel prover subsystem was created.
scope.non_promotion_reason: Every managed native prover and Python solver binding is absent in the authoritative sealed environment. The required PCSM datasets suite cannot load its configured anyio plugin, and its non-plugin collection reaches a second missing dependency, multiformats. The passing focused installer tests are mocked contract tests and cannot establish a real prover deployment or PCSM admission. No canonical PCSM source map, source-bound obligation, digest-bound deployment, kernel receipt, or package-specific PCSM admission test exists. This receipt therefore records a typed honest unavailable/non-promotion disposition.

freshness_check.method: Recorded outer HEAD and HEAD^{tree}; compared all admitted gitlinks with nested HEAD and HEAD^{tree}; checked outer and nested porcelain before receipt creation; recorded selected Git blobs and SHA-256 values; inspected datasets proof-context, optional solver, and Leanstral contracts; searched exact PCSM implementation/test roots for SourceMapResolver, SourceLinkReceipt, and source-map identity; probed native executables, Python solver modules, and managed solver status under the prescribed PATH, Python 3.12, and fresh private HOME/XDG roots; and ran required plus focused validation in that environment.
freshness_check.result: The dispatch commit equals outer HEAD, every recorded nested commit/tree pair equals its checked-out head, and inspected worktrees were clean before this receipt write. The solver installer is current and declares managed versions, but all fourteen reported solver capabilities are missing in the sealed environment. The datasets proof-context port has no theorem-prover capability in its closed v0.1 contract, and no canonical PCSM source-map contract or admission implementation was found.
freshness_check.invalidates_on: Any bound commit/tree, gitlink head/tree, scheduler digest, listed source/test digest, solver target/deployment, proof-context or admission contract, source-map capability, or validation result change requires a fresh receipt.

pcsm_source_map.reason: No current-tree aggregate PCSM SourceLinkReceipt, SourceMapResolver@1, or canonical source-map CID resolves exact PCSM file/node/span identities in the named datasets or accelerator roots. Git trees, blobs, SHA-256 values, local executable names, solver target versions, LegalIR task IDs, and installer status rows are not falsely relabelled as this missing contract.

selected_existing_authorities.minimum_delta_reason: The datasets solver installer is the only located current-head component that inventories versioned external theorem-prover targets without downloading or changing them. Leanstral is the only located component that invokes Lean, but it is expressly a non-mutating LegalIR shadow lane. Reusing their evidence, rather than creating an adapter across their distinct domains, is the smallest authority-preserving result for this receipt-only dispatch.

components.role: Read-only status probe for optional managed solver targets: TLC, Apalache, Tamarin, Maude, ProVerif, cvc5, Vampire, E prover, Lean, Rocq, Isabelle, Z3, SymbolicAI, and ErgoAI.
components.version_binding: Managed targets include Lean v4.31.0, Rocq 9.1.1, Isabelle2025-2, cvc5 1.3.3, Vampire 5.0.1, E prover 3.2.5, and Z3 >=4.12.0,<5.0.0. These are installer compatibility targets, not an installed deployment digest or proof receipt.
components.authority_boundary: The probe reports availability/version drift and performs no download, theorem construction, source-map resolution, proof checking, PCSM admission, mutation, completion, or promotion.

components.role: LegalIR-only shadow proposal validator that checks an explicitly supplied Lean executable, runs a temporary Lean file, and validates its own Python patch proposal contract.
components.version_binding: Leanstral proposal and task schemas are its own LegalIR contracts; no PCSM theorem-obligation schema, source-map CID, current-forest request CID, deployment digest, or kernel-receipt schema is exposed.
components.authority_boundary: Its configuration is explicitly non-mutating and its result is a shadow-lane validation. It does not select a PCSM source identity, admit an M2/M3 mutation, convert a model proposal or process exit code into proof authority, or authorize completion/promotion.

components.role: Closed datasets proof-context port vocabulary for semantic index, capsule, context-pack, sufficiency, and semantic-state assembly.
components.authority_boundary: The declared canonical capabilities omit theorem-prover admission, source-link/source-map resolution, theorem obligations, kernel receipts, and promotion authority.

determinism_and_authority_boundary.binding: managed_solver_version_status deterministically enumerates a fixed ordered solver catalog and reports executable/version presence without installation. The current focused test suite exercises success and failure paths with monkeypatched installers; those tests are simulated contract evidence only. No deterministic PCSM theorem admission CID can be produced without a PCSM source map, source-bound theorem obligation, and installed digest-bound checker.
determinism_and_authority_boundary.boundary: No local alias, model output, installer result, executable lookup, process return code, fixture, or test result is accepted as canonical semantic identity, proof, M2/M3 mutation authority, completion authority, or promotion authority.

limitations: This exact-output dispatch is receipt-only. It does not install software, alter datasets/accelerator code or tests, create a PCSM adapter, download a prover, manufacture a source map, or relax a validation gate.
The solver installer’s managed target versions and artifact checksums are acquisition metadata, not identities of installed sealed binaries and not proof receipts.
Leanstral is a LegalIR shadow lane with its own task/proposal schemas. Its temporary Lean process result does not bind a PCSM source forest or grant PCSM admission authority.

The required datasets proof-context suite is unavailable because its configured anyio plugin is absent; a diagnostic plugin-disabled run independently also found multiformats absent. Neither result is a test pass or zero-test success.

Focused installer tests passed through controlled mocks, so they remain simulated evidence and cannot overcome missing prover deployments, source-map identity, PCSM obligation schema, or formal proof evidence.

No model output, candidate, installer status, test fixture, test result, local executable name, or transport response is accepted as canonical semantic identity, mutation, proof, completion, or promotion authority.
This receipt has no immutable self-CID because adding one would change its bytes.
